# python-testing

Use when the user asks for python testing work.

## Workflow
1. Locate observable behavior and existing test conventions.
2. Write deterministic tests for happy paths, edge cases and failure modes.
3. Mock external I/O rather than business logic.
4. Run the relevant tests when available and explain any unexecuted checks.

## Verification
State which checks were executed, what passed, and what could not be verified. Favor existing project conventions. Use local resources; do not require network access merely to read this skill.
